manual_next_study.next_study_purpose: Find the true minimum packet carrier set after route_law_minimal_field_ablation_v1 showed route law survives single-family ablations when alternate scaffolding remains.
evidence_reviewed: route_law_successor_source_isolation_v1 completed with 18 responded cases and no apparent runner send failure.
Desk-reset positive and conflict cases generally advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes, including wrong-next conflict cases where stack_papers was ignored.
No-active sentinel cases 012 and 018 stayed inert with No active chunk, reducing concern about broad carryover-driven movement.
Case 001 was intended as active-only but still included route_id, so it cannot prove active_chunk_id alone supplies successor resolution.

Synthetic route_id-only case 014 advanced gather_books to align_spines after case 013 had already supplied the synthetic route_sequence, so it may reflect cross-case route teaching rather than route_id-only authority.
manual_next_study.open_gap: The model clearly follows route law once enough route context is present, but the true minimum cold successor carrier remains unknown. It is not yet isolated whether route_id alone can resolve a novel route, whether route_sequence is required, whether legal_successor_chunk_id is sufficient, or whether apparent route_id-only success came from prior-case carryover.
manual_next_study.test_strategy: Run a counterbalanced cold retest with multiple synthetic routes and paired order inversions. Include true active_chunk_id-only cases with no route_id, no route_sequence, no legal_successor, and no next_chunk. Test route_id-only before any sequence exposure for one synthetic route, route_sequence-only before any route_id exposure for another, and legal_successor-only before either route_id or sequence exposure for a third. Repeat wrong-next conflicts after each clean carrier source. Include no-active sentinels at beginning, middle, and end.
recommended_cases: strict full-field control for move_on from clear_trash to collect_dishes
relaxed baseline matching the passing relaxed move_on shape
active_chunk_id plus route_sequence but no next_chunk_id
label-only active chunk and next label without canonical chunk ids
route_sequence-only advancement with no explicit next_chunk field
allowed_intents plus active_chunk only, testing whether move_on can infer one-step advancement
side-question return under the weakest field set that still seems legal
late wrong-next negative control to ensure ablation does not create false route survival
recommended_case_reasons: The previous pointer is satisfied because relaxed contracts preserved route law.
The next uncertainty is the minimal field carrier, not strict versus relaxed wording.
A late negative control remains necessary so reduced packets do not teach the scorer to accept wrong-next movement.
avoid: Do not call a case active-only if route_id is present.
Do not place route_id-only synthetic cases after a route_sequence case for the same synthetic route.
Do not reuse one synthetic route across all carrier tests without counterbalancing order.
Do not treat PASS_CANDIDATE in a taught synthetic route as proof of cold route_id authority.
Do not let next_chunk_id become an authority except as an explicit unsafe-hint probe.
manual_next_study.suite_shape_recommendation: 18 to 24 cases. Use three or four synthetic routes with different first and second chunks. Counterbalance order: route_id-only cold first for one route, route_sequence-only cold first for another, legal_successor-only cold first for another, and active-only/no-successor controls before any exposure. Include wrong-next conflicts and late no-active sentinels.
manual_next_study.retirement_condition: Retire when a clean cold carrier is identified: one field set reliably advances active_chunk_id to the intended legal successor before any prior exposure, absent successor fields do not produce full legal advancement, and wrong next_chunk hints are ignored across both desk-reset and novel synthetic routes.
manual_next_study.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_successor_source_counterbalanced_cold_retest_v1 suite with true active-only controls, multiple synthetic routes, cold first-exposure carrier tests, counterbalanced order, wrong-next conflicts, and no-active sentinels.
manual_next_study.purpose: Retest successor-source authority with clean active-only controls and counterbalanced synthetic-route order so route_id, route_sequence, legal_successor_chunk_id, and wrong next_chunk hints can be separated without carryover contamination.

manual_notes.follow_up_repair_note: Current concern: messy tests pile up without enough reflection, planning, ownership of the next-test status, or cumulative analysis surface. Make the post-run digest mandatory before the next suite is designed.
manual_notes.ownership_rule: The design/review chat proposes the next study from the result; the import/tabulation/status layer records the current next-study pointer; fresh chats must read this status before creating new suites; completed manual next-study agendas must be explicitly retired before the next fresh-chat design cycle.
manual_notes.window_model: Design chat creates/reviews JSON, Casework GUI validates/runs setup, disposable ChatGPT test tab executes the runner.
manual_notes.cumulative_map_rule: One-off result reviews should guide the immediate next move, but every case should also append high-detail normalized data to a single case-law/rule-design matrix for later analysis.
manual_notes.legal_integration_rule: The Orion TTD legal system should stay woven into the test pipeline so results can be read through committed state, evidence, prose-as-claim, signals, smallest legal reduction, HOLD/REPAIR/REANCHOR, and PASS/FAIL route-survival language.
manual_notes.integration_simplification_question: As these parts are connected, decide whether each part should stay separate, collapse into another artifact, or be redesigned because it overlaps or adds too much maintenance. Keep pieces that reduce confusion; simplify anything that becomes a second source of truth.
manual_notes.rulebook_update_needed: Add a concise rule to ttdmobile_coding_rulebook.md so agents know how to use the reflection loop, cumulative case-law matrix, and legal-system test interpretation before modifying Casework study/status/review flows.

integration_open_question: Collapse or redesign overlapping artifacts if they become duplicate sources of truth.

resolved_findings.summary: Post-run follow-up is weak. Result JSON should be digested into Mermaid review, pass/failure summary, tool/scorer/language classification, an explicit next-study status update, and a cumulative case-law matrix append before any new suite is designed.
